About.heading: What is
About.body: Safolio is an independent investment platform that brings together all your assets — stocks, crypto, ETFs, gold, and more — into one place. With advanced risk analysis, it helps you make smarter decisions and guides you on your path to financial freedom.

intro.title: Independent, empowering, simple and risk-smart
intro.body: Safolio is more than just a portfolio tracker — it's your companion on the path to financial freedom. No matter what assets you hold, Safolio helps you see the bigger picture, understand your risks, refine your strategy, and take action with ease.

independent.title: Truly Independent
independent.body: Not tied to any bank or broker. Every calculation and analysis is built for your benefit and trust.

multiAsset.title: Multi-Asset Support
multiAsset.body: From stocks to crypto, funds to gold, manage and evaluate all your investments in one place.

journal.title: Integrated Trading Journal
journal.body: Learn from your past and plan your future. Track all your moves in the simplest way.

risk.title: Smart Risk Analysis
risk.body: No surprises. Let advanced tools work for you, so you can stay in control and enjoy managing your investments yourself.

community.title: Community Driven
community.body: Learn, share, and grow together. Safolio opens the doors to a community of investors managing their own portfolios.

audience.label: Who is Safolio for?
items: New investors taking their very first steps into the world of investing
Experienced investors and traders looking for smarter tools and deeper insights
Those managing both crypto and traditional assets together
Investment communities that love to share knowledge
Savers who want to turn their money into investments with reliable insights
Financial professionals seeking advanced analysis and clarity
Thought leaders and influencers shaping the future of finance
audience.outro: Wherever you are on your investment journey, Safolio gives you the tools to guide your way and a community to walk alongside you.

why.label: Why Safolio?
items: Transparent with a simple, intuitive experience
Trustworthy — you stay in control of your own decisions
Enables those with small savings to start investing
Provides professionals with all the tools they need in one place

WhyWeCreated.heading: Why Did We Create
paragraphs: We believe investing is a right for everyone, no matter the size of their savings. Too many investors get lost in scattered platforms and overwhelming information. As investors ourselves, searching for the best way to grow our money, we built Safolio.

Safolio is a trustworthy, independent platform that empowers you to make your own decisions with confidence — backed by unbiased analysis and advanced risk insights. As you plan for your future, you're no longer alone. Safolio is with you 24/7, helping you take control and make the right moves on your investment journey.

CTA.body: Forget what you thought you knew about finance — a new era is beginning, and this time, you're in control.
